parts.label: (ii)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: $y=(x-2)^2+2\Rightarrow x-2=(\pm)\sqrt{y-2}\Rightarrow x=(\pm)\sqrt{y-2}+2$. M1. Order of operations correct; allow sign errors. $f^{-1}(x)=\sqrt{x-2}+2$. A1. Accept $y=\sqrt{x-2}+2$. Domain of $f^{-1}$ is $x\ge6$; allow $\ge6$. B1. Not $f^{-1}(x)\ge6$. Not $f(x)\ge6$. Not $y\ge6$. Total: 3.
